name: Arlberghöhe
beschreibung: The Arlberghöhe is a hotel in Sankt Anton am Arlberg, Tyrol. It is situated right in the center of the village in the immediate vicinity of the ski lifts. The hotel features a variety of room and suite categories. Amenities include a wellness area, restaurants, and a bar. The accommodation serves as an ideal base for skiing and hiking activities throughout the region. Sankt Anton is renowned for its world-class ski area and summer hiking trails. The hotel offers concierge services and sports equipment storage, and parking is available in the underground garage.
